Lendi

Working demo of the Banking & Payments quest. Tap through it like a student who just landed.

  1. Intro, then pick Just landed and tick what's in your kit
  2. On the map, open Banking & Payments. Tap Compare banks near you and check your kit AI
  3. Open Open your account, then tap I'm stuck
  4. Pick Something else and describe a problem in your own words AI
  5. On the Grapevine tab, tap Share a tip. Try one with a card number in it AI
  6. Tap I opened my account and clear the quest
